source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever one of your units arrives through **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, its models' attacks re-roll every **Hit roll** of 1 as well as every **Wound roll** of 1, until the turn ends.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 296 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
